description:
[Protocol Health Oracle] Force an immediate sync of the tracked-protocol universe from DefiLlama (TVL > $1M). Runs automatically once/day; use this to trigger it on demand.

Use when you want the tracked universe re-synced from DefiLlama (TVL above $1M), which also runs automatically on a schedule. Not for routine reads.

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.
name: protocol_health_sync_universe
